commit_chain.message: feat: add capability-aware vector and retrieval schema
feat: add capability-bound vector and collection identities
feat: index candidate and active binding vectors
feat: snapshot and regenerate capability cutovers and atomically activate
feat: bind side-channel namespaces and add cutover commands
test: seal P0.4A2 capability-bound vector lifecycle

exclusions: No vector_index_v2 production eligibility without activation
No external I/O inside activation transaction

defect_c.title: Guard release unconditional by profile_id only
defect_c.fix: Guard release now filters by profile_id + cutover_id + state=frozen

defect_a.title: Capability-bound retrieval primitives not wired into scoped_vector_service
defect_a.fix: scoped_vector_service.py now resolves RetrievalBindingContext and uses posture-aware eligibility

defect_b.title: V1 indexer has no write-guard; v2 indexer not called from production
defect_b.fix: V1 indexer consults write guard + activation posture. Post-activation v1 writes permanently forbidden.

defect_d.title: Side-channel namespace policy not wired into semantic_cache
defect_d.fix: provider_factory.py passes cache_namespace derived from embedding model

defect_e.title: Post-activation v1 writes not blocked (guard released by activation)
defect_e.fix: V1 indexer now checks for active binding activation in addition to write guard

roadmap_posture.P0.4A3: READY — final operator/product integration and end-to-end seal
